# FemTech World

> > The leading digital hub for women's health innovation, connecting femtech companies, research, and industry news across menopause, fertility, pregnancy, mental health, and reproductive wellness.

FemTech World is a comprehensive platform covering the femtech sector through news, events, and industry insights. It aggregates research, tracks emerging technologies like wearables and AI, and connects stakeholders including entrepreneurs, healthcare providers, and women's health advocates.

## Key Topics

- Femtech
- Women's Health
- Reproductive Health
- Wearable Technology
- Digital Health
- Pregnancy & Maternal Health
- Menopause
- Fertility
- Mental Health
- AI & Health Technology
- Research & Clinical Studies
- Health Innovation
- Women Entrepreneurs
- Hormone Tracking

## Core Hub & Navigation

- [Home - FemTech World](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk): FemTech World homepage covering menopause, fertility, pregnancy, motherhood, mental health
- [Latest News - FemTech World](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/latest-news): News aggregator for women's health, pregnancy, menopause, fertility, mental health topics
- [Dates for your diary - FemTech World](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/femtech-events): FemTech event calendar and directory for conferences, workshops, networking opportunities
- [Advertise - FemTech World](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/advertise): Advertising, sponsorship and partnership opportunities for femtech sector stakeholders

## Femtech Innovation & Industry

- [Luna and Kindbody partner to bring data-driven insight to women's health and fertility care](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/news/luna-and-kindbody-partner-to-bring-data-driven-insight-to-womens-health-and-fertility-care-fert26): Luna wearables and Kindbody fertility platform partnership for personalized health insights
- [Oura launches women's health AI model](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/news/hormonal-health/oura-launches-womens-health-ai-model): Oura wearable ring launches proprietary AI model for reproductive health personalization
- [Menstrual health apps market tipped to reach US$13bn](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/news/menstrual-health-apps-market-tipped-to-reach-us13bn-mens26): Market forecast shows menstrual health apps growth from US$2.07bn to US$13.11bn by 2035
- [Halogen Ventures surpasses 100 investments in female-founded startups](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/entrepreneur/halogen-ventures-surpasses-100-investments-in-female-founded-startups-ftsu26): Halogen Ventures reaches 100+ investments in female-founded startups worth US$15bn+
- [How AI is shaping the future of women's health](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/international-womens-day-2026/how-ai-is-shaping-the-future-of-womens-health-ftai26): International Women's Day 2026 expert perspectives on AI in women's health and femtech

## Research & Clinical Health Insights

- [Premature menopause raises long-term heart risk by 40%, study finds](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/news/menopause-news/premature-menopause-raises-long-term-heart-risk-by-40-study-finds): Northwestern University study finds premature menopause increases coronary heart disease risk 40%
- [Physical activity may reduce hypertension risk in pregnancy](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/news/pregnancy/physical-activity-may-reduce-hypertension-risk-in-pregnancy-cvh26): University of Iowa research on physical activity reducing pregnancy hypertension risk by 30%
- [Experts call for better type 2 diabetes care for pregnant women](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/news/pregnancy/experts-call-for-better-type-2-diabetes-care-for-pregnant-women-cvh26): Urgent action needed for type 2 diabetes care before, during, and after pregnancy
- [Commission to tackle long-neglected field of women's mental health](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/news/mental-health/commission-to-tackle-long-neglected-field-of-womens-mental-health-ftmh26): Lancet Psychiatry Commission establishes evidence-based standard for women-centered mental health
- [The missing layer in the women's health conversation](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/international-womens-day-2026/the-missing-layer-in-the-womens-health-conversation-ftcomp26): International Women's Day 2026 discussion on hormone tracking and medical research gaps

## Maternity & Postnatal Care

- [The maternity care crisis hiding in plain sight](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/news/motherhood/the-maternity-care-crisis-hiding-in-plain-sight-ftcomp26): Adrianne Nickerson from Oula discusses maternity care crisis and collaborative care models
- [The 4th trimester and the new standard in postnatal care](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/news/pregnancy/the-4th-trimester-and-the-new-standard-in-postnatal-care-ul26): NICE guidelines and NHS standards for fourth trimester postnatal care and recovery

- [Peers push to pardon women criminalised under abortion laws](https://www.femtechworld.co.uk/wellness/peers-push-to-pardon-women-criminalised-under-abortion-laws-fert26): House of Lords debates abortion law changes to pardon women in England and Wales
